project.name: melanablac
project.productType: Independent art and illustrated greeting card storefront

decisions: Contemporary editorial gallery: warm paper, ink, muted olive, restrained gold.
Use original artwork and existing films; no stock replacements.
Keep the real catalogue, category filters, basket, checkout, contact and administration.
Remove external marketplace links and editable marketplace settings.
Muted films without visible playback buttons; honour reduced motion.
Preserve the original signature logo using public/logo-dark.png on ivory, in both header and footer.
